# Matla (مطلع)

> Matla is a free Arabic prayer-times app for iPhone and Apple Watch, made by Mohamed Zakaria El-Zoghbi (ZaPlatform, Cairo). Egypt first: the Egyptian General Authority of Survey method (Fajr 19.5°, Isha 17.5°) is the default. No ads, no accounts, no tracking across apps; the location never leaves the phone. The app's interface is Arabic only. Available now, free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6813938812

## Pages
- [مطلع بالعربية](https://matla.zaplatform.com/): the main page, with every feature, screenshots and the FAQ.
- [Matla in English](https://matla.zaplatform.com/en/): the same facts in English.
- [Privacy policy](https://matla.zaplatform.com/privacy/) ([English](https://matla.zaplatform.com/en/privacy/)): no account or ads; anonymous usage and crash data via Google Firebase, switchable off in Settings; location stays on the device.
- [Terms of use](https://matla.zaplatform.com/terms/) ([English](https://matla.zaplatform.com/en/terms/)): including the optional tips and the auto-renewing monthly thank-you subscription.

## Facts
- Prayer times: Egyptian General Authority of Survey (default), Umm al-Qura, Muslim World League, Karachi, ISNA and others; Asr school; per-prayer minute adjustment.
- Adhan: several voices and a separate Fajr voice, Time Sensitive notifications; iOS caps a notification sound at 30 seconds, and the app plays the full adhan when opened.
- Fajr alarm: an iOS system alarm (AlarmKit) that rings on silent or in a Focus, with an optional wake-up task (say the dhikr, walk, or scan a code) and a bedtime reminder worked back from Fajr.
- Quran: the whole mushaf in the King Fahd Complex script (1441 AH print) with tajweed colours, offline; recitations from more than thirty reciters, with downloadable surahs.
- Worship: morning, evening, sleep, waking and after-prayer athkar with sources; your own athkar («أذكاري»); tasbih; Qibla compass; Umm al-Qura Hijri calendar with a one- or two-day adjustment; occasions (Friday and al-Kahf, Sunnah fasts, Ramadan, the Eids).
- Live: Makkah and Madinah via the Saudi Broadcasting Authority's official YouTube channels; Holy Quran Radio from Cairo.
- Widgets (Home Screen, Lock Screen, StandBy), an optional Live Activity, and an Apple Watch app (times, Qibla, Digital Crown tasbih, complications).
- Price: free. Optional tips and a monthly thank-you subscription unlock nothing.
- Needs iOS 26.1 or later. No Android version yet.
- Contact: zaplatform@gmail.com
